'''Bel Corek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]], Bel Corek signed up to join the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] but later defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He became a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] and was given command of [[Silverblade X-wing squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] based at [[DVL-181]] on a swampy [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="HS" />
